latest_interim.detail: Acquisitions +6.6%, FX -1.5%. Q3 2026 alone: organic +1.6%, acquisitions +5.6%, FX +1.1%, reported +8.3%. 'All business areas except Dental reported organic growth' in 9M 2026 (Dental net sales +3.7% 'due to acquisitions').

geography.basis_note: Net sales by geographic market 2025: Germany 15%, United Kingdom 13%, Finland 9%, Sweden 9%, Norway 7%, Italy 6%, Rest of Europe 23% (Total Europe 82%), North America 9%, Asia and Australia 8%, Rest of world 1%. em_other_pct = Asia & Australia + RoW. China not disclosed.

claim_checks.finding: Lifco does not publish numeric organic growth by business area in its reports; only qualitative statements. FY2025: 'organic growth in every business area' (Group +4.2%; Demolition & Tools and Systems Solutions grew organically; parts of Systems Solutions negative). 9M 2026: all business areas except Dental grew organically; Dental sales growth (+3.7%) came from acquisitions, i.e. Dental organic was negative/flat. Group organic 2023 0.0% and 2024 -0.5% were driven by weak Demolition & Tools - the record's 2026 figures (Q1 1.2, H1 2.9, 9M 2.5) are confirmed but the record omitted the two near-zero years.

claim_checks.finding: Now quantified: Europe 82%, North America 9%, Asia & Australia 8%; largest country Germany 15%; Sweden only 9%.
